summary: Completed a comprehensive archaeological catalog of the yy_Archive folder (642 files, 64 MB, 11 subfolders). Discovered that 33% of files (211 of 642) are exact duplicates across 96 duplicate groups, with the worst offenders appearing in 5 separate locations. Identified 10 content categories ranging from novel chapter drafts to Cursor tool documentation. Flagged 7 other novels buried in the archive, 18 empty placeholder files, 2 empty subfolders, and near-complete folder-level duplication between Extra_Files_Archive and Original_Writing_Archive. Wrote the full report to yy_Archive/ARCHIVE_CATALOG.md (449 lines) with recommendations for cleanup that could reduce the archive from 642 to ~410 unique files.
current_status: ARCHIVE_CATALOG.md has been written to yy_Archive/ with complete inventory, content categories, duplicate analysis, files flagged as possibly still needed, and cleanup recommendations. Ready for Timothy to review and decide on next steps (deduplication, moving other novels out, consolidation).
